summary: Extract shared storefront customer journeys and separate historical customer access from new login and order intake policy.
noAssistantImpact: Customer identity, OTP, receipt capability proofs, request recovery and customer-initiated actions remain excluded from model tools and ordinary model input. Existing domain commands remain canonical. Shared UI and template configuration do not grant permission. Existing Host/published Site/active release/Store scope and current entitlement checks remain; new login effects recheck publication under a Site lock while valid session/history/receipt reads do not depend on the selected template or new-intake policy. No new protected merchant procedure, assistant capability, provider activation or deployment. Future neutral feature settings must retain existing Owner/Admin draft/save/publication authority and explicit consent; design generation cannot silently alter operational configuration.

docs.note: Existing customer/request/Site records and JSON composition storage; no Prisma schema edit in this extraction.

evidence.result: Independent login/order configuration, legacy normalization, unknown versions and entitlement/channel refusal pass in offline tests.

The shared scope resolver interface passes template-switch/history continuity, foreign-host denial, invalid publication/pin/runtime refusal and exact active-Store scope tests with isolated adapters. This is not connected transaction/concurrency proof.

Owner-authorized 27-work-package local extraction contract preserves customer/session/token/bag compatibility, immutable releases and no-deployment boundary. Full template/UI/transaction acceptance remains open until the final phase.
